newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas falls, only trades in back months.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas falls, only trades in back months.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market was weaker on Tuesday, but only three of the 12 monthly contracts were traded.
The October, December and February contracts all closed lower, with February shedding 0.15 pence a therm while the other two lost 0.275 pence a therm each.

The total volume traded, 150 lots, was higher than in recent days. But the total was boosted three minutes before the contract closed, when 60 February lots were traded in two deals. Until then, only 25 lots had been done in the afternoon session in three separate trades in October.

Brokers had expected prices to fall, with both futures and physical markets looking weak since the weekend when the flexibility mechanism traded at negative prices and gave a bearish tone to the whole market.
But the front months did not trade at all, although bids were well below the previous day's settlement price on every contract month and many still expect further falls.
